target.label: Capture target
target.description: Sink name to monitor. Empty uses the default audio output.

fps.label: Frame rate
fps.description: How often the waveform refreshes, in frames per second.

cols.label: Horizontal resolution
cols.description: Number of waveform columns across the widget.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: Amplitude gain. Higher shows quieter audio larger.

gate.label: Silence threshold
gate.description: Level below which the trace is drawn flat.

width.label: Width
width.description: Width of the waveform in pixels.

height.label: Height
height.description: Height of the waveform in pixels.

color2.label: Band color
color2.description: Color of the lower envelope when the band view is enabled.

line_width.label: Line width
line_width.description: Width of the waveform line in pixels.

fill_opacity.label: Fill opacity
fill_opacity.description: Opacity of the area under the trace, from 0 to 0.6.

draw_band.label: Draw envelope band
draw_band.description: Fill the min/max envelope instead of drawing a single line.

show_meter_labels.label: Meter labels
show_meter_labels.description: Show the RMS/PK text next to the level meters.

rms_color.label: RMS meter color
rms_color.description: Color of the RMS level meter bar.

peak_color.label: Peak meter color
peak_color.description: Color of the peak level meter bar.

meter_radius.label: Meter corner radius
meter_radius.description: Corner radius of the meter bars, in pixels.

meter_width.label: Meter width
meter_width.description: Maximum width of the level meter bars in pixels.

meter_height.label: Meter height
meter_height.description: Height of the level meter bars in pixels.

meter_gap.label: Meter spacing
meter_gap.description: Gap between the waveform and the level meters, in pixels.

widget.build_failed: Helper build failed: install cc, make, pkg-config and the libpipewire-0.3 development headers, then run make in the plugin's native/ directory.
